postal_system.assignment_rule: Keep the EA ledger identity and the two source members separate: 51xxx is Ceuta and 52xxx is Melilla. A normalized code is an identifier first; area semantics require exact same-code geometry and rights.
postal_system.geometry_rule: CartoCiudad WMS may prove one official-view Polygon at an observed time but its documentation says the postcode surfaces are view-only and not downloadable. A Point, office, locality, autonomous-city boundary, buffer, hull, Voronoi cell, model result or AGID cell must never replace postal geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: Postal code, sourced street/address candidate, administrative context, building and independent AGID spatial ID are separately typed. More-detailed display is allowed only with its own source and confidence.
postal_system.agid_rule: An EA AGID may identify the selected map position independently; it is not the Correos postcode, a postal polygon, an exact building or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.model_rule: Hugging Face and open-source models may assist multilingual parsing, candidate ranking and anomaly review after source and rights gates. They cannot create an assignment, official boundary, licence, address-building relation or delivery fact.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires a separately licensed civic-address/building source and explicit stable relation; spatial proximity is insufficient.
postal_system.licence_rule: CNIG documents CartoCiudad postcode surfaces as visualization-only and datos.gob.es states Correos is the sole distributor. Correos Data is commercial with transfer, sublicensing and Internet finder restrictions. No contract or purchase was attempted.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: EA is traversed in Africa per the rollout ledger while its existing Europe-source address record remains intact. Do not absorb EA into ES, IC, PT or Morocco and do not collapse Ceuta and Melilla into one geometry.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Retain retrieval timestamp, exact response bytes, SHA-256, CartoCiudad database timestamp and source date. Re-check only after the pending-country sweep or a rights-cleared complete release.

stages.definition: Legacy EA address metadata covered Ceuta only and accepted only 51xxx.

Current 51xxx/52xxx normalization, distinct Ceuta/Melilla identity, digest-bound official references, one official-view 51001 Polygon quality receipt, explicit rights limits, and real API/app blocked-state evidence.

M2 requires a complete current finite denominator of every EA Correos assignment, alias, validity, correction, exception and area/non-area type plus exact corresponding Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry, all in immutable versioned artifacts under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The real EA API/app must expose normalization, loading, no-match, multiple, failure and invalid-geometry states; fit a valid surface; render translucent fill and clear outline over a base map; show selected postcode, geometry type, official/derived/virtual class, source, date and confidence; clear and re-search; and keep address, building and AGID identity separately sourced.

agid_integration.current_scope: EA format and source metadata, official-view geometry QA and source-qualified address/AGID display only; no EA Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A complete immutable rights-cleared EA assignment and postal-geometry release must pass topology, prefix/member, API and application checks.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: No official-view receipt, autonomous-city polygon, point, model or AGID cell is published as Postal Context geometry.
